facts.text: The hotel is on the western shore of Lake Como with views toward Bellagio.
facts.excerpt: Set along the western shore, with sweeping Bellagio views

facts.text: The hotel reimagines a historic 19th-century palazzo with contemporary design.
facts.excerpt: reimagining a historic 19th-century palazzo with refined contemporary design

facts.text: Rooms have custom furnishings by Neri&Hu.
facts.excerpt: each designed as a serene retreat with custom furnishings by Neri&Hu and refined Italian detailing throughout

facts.text: Room interiors use Calacatta marble, bespoke walnut and soft blue tones inspired by the lake.
facts.excerpt: Interiors blend Calacatta marble, bespoke walnut, and soft blue tones inspired by the lake itself.

facts.text: Many rooms have restored French balconies with views of Lake Como, the Bellagio promontory and the surrounding peaks.
facts.excerpt: Many rooms feature restored French balconies with sweeping views of Lake Como, the Bellagio promontory, and the surrounding peaks.

facts.text: Cetino is Mauro Colagreco's first restaurant in Italy.
facts.excerpt: Cetino is Mauro Colagreco’s first restaurant in Italy

facts.text: Cetino cooks with hyper-seasonal ingredients and local producers.
facts.excerpt: Cetino brings circular gastronomy to life with hyper-seasonal ingredients, local producers

facts.text: Renzo is an all-day restaurant with a pergola-shaded terrace and lake views.
facts.excerpt: The space opens onto a pergola-shaded terrace framed by Mediterranean herbs, citrus trees, and lake views

facts.text: The Lobby Bar serves aperitivo beneath five-meter vaulted ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Aperitivo unfolds beneath five-meter vaulted ceilings and celadon marble elegance.

facts.text: The hotel has a floating pool and a private dock with waterfront access.
facts.excerpt: a floating pool, a private dock, and waterfront access provide a seamless connection to the lake

facts.text: The spa has an indoor vitality pool with floor-to-ceiling lake views, a steam bath, a herbal sauna and a plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: an indoor vitality pool with floor-to-ceiling lake views, a steam bath, herbal sauna, a plunge pool

facts.text: Spa visits begin with an expert-led assessment of sleep quality, inflammation and oxidative stress.
facts.excerpt: Guests begin with an expert-led assessment, measuring sleep quality, inflammation, oxidative stress, and more

facts.text: The minimum age for spa access is 18.
facts.excerpt: Please be informed that minimum age for spa access is 18 years.

facts.text: Room service is available for breakfast only.
The hotel offers curated experiences including scenic boat tours and wellness rituals.
facts.excerpt: curated experiences—from scenic boat tours to immersive wellness rituals

facts.text: A taxi from Lugano Airport crosses the Switzerland-Italy border, and tolls and luggage fees may apply.
facts.excerpt: The journey includes an international border crossing Switzerland and Italy (tolls and luggage fees may apply).
